title: Program Semantic Inequivalence Game with Large Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2505.03818v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) can achieve strong performance on everyday coding tasks, but they can fail on complex tasks that require non-trivial reasoning about program semantics. Finding training examples to teach LLMs to solve these tasks can be challenging.   In this work, we explore a method to synthetically generate code reasoning training data based on a semantic inequivalence game (SInQ): a generator agent creates program variants that are semantically distinct, derived from a dataset of real-world programming tasks, while an evaluator agent has to identify input examples for which they behave differently. The agents train each other semi-adversarially, improving their ability to understand the underlying logic of code. translated_title: 基于大语言模型的程序语义不等价博弈
translated_abstract: 大型语言模型（LLMs）在日常编码任务中表现出色，但在需要复杂程序语义推理的任务上可能失败。寻找训练示例来教导LLMs解决这些任务具有挑战性。在本工作中，我们探索了一种基于语义不等价博弈（SInQ）的合成代码推理训练数据生成方法：生成器智能体从真实世界编程任务数据集中创建语义不同的程序变体，而评估器智能体必须识别出它们行为不同的输入示例。这两个智能体以半对抗方式互相训练，提升对代码底层逻辑的理解能力。我们在多个代码生成和理解基准上评估了该方法，包括跨语言漏洞检测（Lu等人，2021），其中我们的方法提升了漏洞检测性能。
tldr: 提出一种基于语义不等价博弈的半对抗训练方法，通过生成器和评估器智能体的相互博弈来合成代码推理训练数据，从而提升大语言模型在复杂程序语义理解和漏洞检测等任务上的能力。
en_tdlr: Proposes a semantic inequivalence game-based semi-adversarial training method that synthesizes code reasoning data through generator-evaluator agent interaction, enhancing LLMs' performance on complex program semantics understanding and vulnerability detection tasks.
